decision_text: The owner explicitly carries the prior accepted G4 auth-family visual decision forward to the exact finished r6 successor after being informed that its visible result is unchanged. This acceptance covers the represented sign-in and recovery states, stable per-screen geometry, semantic controls, copy boundary, layout grammar, responsive Web anchors and applicable pilot inheritance shown in the hash-bound r6 review board. It does not authorize production implementation, publication, deployment, mobile-specific design, another G4 family, G5, G6 or full WCAG conformance.

accepted_values.stable_window_geometry: each screen preserves its exact initial-state dimensions across every represented state
